completion.message:
The production portal recovered. Both load-balancer backends are `HEALTHY`, and a fresh request to `https://emisar.dev/` returned application content rather than a 503.

The earlier 503 cause is still unverified: current evidence can't distinguish a brief no-healthy-backend interval from an application-generated 503. If it recurs, `statusDetails=failed_to_pick_backend` in the load-balancer logs will distinguish them.

completion.summary: Production portal is currently healthy; the transient 503's cause remains unverified.
